name: dsh-memory-archive
description: DSH bundle: for every compaction, write a greppable segment_NNN.md holding the checkpoint summary plus the verbatim shadowed turns, maintain INDEX.md, and inject a pointer so the model can recover early tool output. Optionally hands each finished segment to an experience-extraction endpoint (fire-and-forget: a dead endpoint never affects the archive). Same-session only.

description.en: For every compaction, writes a greppable segment file with the verbatim shadowed turns, maintains an index, and injects a pointer so early tool output stays reachable.
description.zh: 每次压缩把被折叠的逐字轮次写成可 grep 的段落文件，维护索引并注入指针，让早期工具输出在长会话里仍可检索。

author: leganck
